scenes.caption: What if a city was struck by an outbreak of uncontrollable dancing? In the summer of 1518, people in Strasbourg began dancing uncontrollably. Contemporary and later accounts describe a troubling outbreak that baffled the city.
historical_constraints: Depict the 1518 dancing outbreak as a documented but contested historical episode; do not present supernatural causation as fact.
